summary.text: Julie Pazina is a Democratic member of the Nevada State Senate who has represented District 12 since 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. Ballotpedia lists her profession as national sales director.

paragraphs.text: Julie Pazina was born in Kansas City, Missouri, and earned a bachelor's degree from Vanderbilt University in 1999.

Her career experience includes working as national director of sales for Edlen Electrical Exhibition Services, and she has been affiliated with the Las Vegas Hospitality Association, Commission on Tourism, Junior League of Las Vegas, Nevada Conservation League, International Association of Exhibitions and Events, and International Association of Venue Managers.
She assumed office on November 9, 2022, succeeding Joseph Hardy.
For the 2025-2026 session she was assigned to the Senate Commerce and Labor (as chair), Senate Growth and Infrastructure (as vice chair), and Senate Natural Resources committees.
Her Republican opponent in the 2026 general election is Rafael Arroyo-Montalvo.
